legendary_actions.desc: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
special_abilities.desc: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Undead Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy's lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

bonus_actions.name: Horror Nimbus
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. Success: The target is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Pursuit
reactions.desc: _Trigger:_ Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. _Response:_ The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.

special_abilities.name: Demonic Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** Detect Magic, Etherealness, Magic Missile
- **2/Day Each:** Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting
actions.desc:
1/día.
Forma: Requires Soul Bag.
While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell. If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag, and the target can't be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

- **At Will:**
- **1/Day Each:** Dream, Protection from Evil and Good, Magic Circle

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Soul Bag
special_abilities.desc: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action. The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

srd-2024_nightmare.name: Nightmare
srd-2024_nightmare.languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, And Infernal but can't speak

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Ethereal Stride
actions.desc: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Confer Fire Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

special_abilities.name: Illumination
special_abilities.desc: The nightmare sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: _Trigger_: The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

srd-2024_ochre-jelly.name: Ochre Jelly
srd-2024_ochre-jelly.condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: _Trigger:_ While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. _Response:_ The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Ink Cloud
reactions.desc:
1/día.
_Trigger:_ A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the octopus while underwater. Response: The octopus releases ink that fills a 5-foot Cube centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

special_abilities.name: Compression
special_abilities.desc: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

srd-2024_ogre-zombie.name: Ogre Zombie
srd-2024_ogre-zombie.languages: Understands Common and Giant but can't speak

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Undead Fortitude
special_abilities.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:**
- **1/Day Each:** Charm Person, Darkness, Gaseous Form, Sleep

bonus_actions.name: Invisibility
bonus_actions.desc: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

srd-2024_otyugh.languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 1 Slashing damage.

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: The owl doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: The panther takes the Disengage or Hide action.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

bonus_actions.desc: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

special_abilities.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
